## Contributor Checklist
Please check all the boxes below before submitting your Pull Request:

- [ ] **CLA:** I accept the project's Contributor Copyright Assignment and License Agreement.
- [ ] **AI Transparency & Ownership:** If AI was used, I have declared the model/settings, I thoroughly understand every line of submitted code, and I can defend it during review.
- [ ] **No AI Slop / Full Testing:** This code has been rigorously tested in a local environment.
- [ ] **No Malicious Code:** I confirm this submission contains no backdoors, malware, or secret-harvesting logic.
- [ ] **Privacy:** I am aware of the public nature of GitHub contributions and have taken appropriate privacy measures if desired.

---
*PRs with unchecked boxes or unverified AI code will be closed.*
